decision.rationale: TXN-007872 (36727 EUR minor units, RIVERSIDE GADGETS, card CRD-000001) posted on 2026-06-19. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-29, 132 days later. That is past the 120-day limit in time-limits. The policy says this limit applies even when the transaction carries fraud indicators. The authorisation AUTH-008084 was an e-commerce payment with 3-D Secure not performed, no CVV and the fraud flag set, which would otherwise have pointed to an unauthorised card-not-present payment. Because the time limit is applied first, the dispute must be declined.

proposed_actions.reason: The dispute was opened on 2026-10-29, 132 days after the transaction posted on 2026-06-19. Disputes must be opened within 120 days of the posting date, so this one cannot be accepted.
